meta.interpretation: Compare phases for trials involving pembrolizumab vs nivolumab

assumptions: Interpreted 'trials involving pembrolizumab vs nivolumab' as trials matched by intervention name, using the intervention field for each drug.
Interpreted 'compare phases' as a phase distribution comparison, counting trials grouped by the categorical phases field.
A trial can appear in both legs if it involves both pembrolizumab and nivolumab, because each leg independently matches its intervention.
No restriction was applied on study type, status, dates, sponsor, or results reporting because none were specified.

warnings: 'Not Applicable' and 'Not Reported' together are roughly 63% of the registry. Combination phases (e.g. Phase 1/Phase 2) form their own bucket and are never double-counted into Phase 1 and Phase 2, so these totals will not match ClinicalTrials.gov's own phase facets, which do double-count.
290 trial membership(s) are shared between legs; the compared populations overlap and do not sum to a distinct total.
10 datum(s) carry no citation because the value labels something the registry does not state — an absent field reported as its own bucket has no text to quote.
